name: Conversation Tools
description: Agent tools for conversation questions, inspection, titles, and working directory changes.

tools.name: conversation
tools.title: Conversation
tools.description: Ask the user, inspect conversations, set the title, change working directory, or schedule a deferred resume for this conversation.
tools.promptSnippet: Use conversation for conversation/session state, questions, inspection, title, cwd changes, and deferred resumes.
promptGuidelines: Use action="deferred_resume" for wait-then-continue; do not run sleep in bash.
Ask the user only when blocked on a real decision or approval.

question.description: Legacy single-question form. Use questions[] for multiple questions or check-style questions.

details.description: Optional overall context, or legacy single-question context when question is used alone.

options.description: Legacy quick-reply options for a single-question prompt.

questions.description: Structured questions to render in the desktop UI. Prefer this for multiple questions and radio/check layouts.

details.description: Optional supporting context for this question.

style.description: radio for one choice, check/checkbox for multi-select.

value.description: Stable value sent back when selected.

label.description: User-facing option label. Defaults to value.

details.description: Optional supporting text shown under the option.

inspectAction.description: Action to perform for inspect. Valid values: list, search, query, diff, outline, read_window.

conversationId.description: Required conversation id for query, outline, read_window, and diff actions.

scope.description: List scope. Valid values: all, live, running, archived.

cwd.description: Target working directory or optional cwd filter for list actions. Relative paths resolve from the current conversation cwd.

query.description: Query string for list/search actions. List matches metadata; search matches visible transcript text.

includeCurrent.description: Whether list should include the current conversation. Defaults to false.

types.description: Optional structural transcript block types to include. Valid values: user, text, context, summary, tool_use, image, error.

roles.description: Optional conversational roles to include. Valid values: user, assistant, tool, context, summary, image, error.

tools.description: Optional tool names to match for tool_use/error blocks.

searchMode.description: How query/text matching works. Valid values: phrase, allTerms, anyTerm. Default phrase.

afterBlockId.description: Only include transcript blocks after this block id.

beforeBlockId.description: Only include transcript blocks before this block id.

aroundBlockId.description: Restrict query results to a context window around this block id.

knownSignature.description: Last seen conversation signature for diff checks.

order.description: Block order for query results. Valid values: asc, desc.

window.description: Context window size for aroundBlockId queries.

includeAroundMatches.description: Include surrounding context blocks around each match using window.

maxSnippetCharacters.description: Character cap per returned search snippet.

title.description: Short, specific conversation title. Aim for 3-7 words and keep it under 80 characters.

continuePrompt.description: Optional prompt to continue automatically in the new working directory after the switch completes.

reason.description: Required when scheduling a wakeup that references a running background run which already delivers completion, explaining the distinct time-based action.
